headline: Payment Fees on $50 Tips & Small Sales
description: What processors take on a $50 tip, micro-invoice, or download. Fixed fees dominate at this size — compare Stripe, PayPal G&S, micropayments, and Venmo.

mainEntity.name: Is PayPal cheaper than Stripe on a $50 payment?

acceptedAnswer.text: On default US schedules in our dataset, PayPal Send/Receive Money G&S ($1.50) undercuts Stripe US ($1.75) because G&S has no fixed fee. PayPal Checkout with the $0.49 fixed fee is usually more expensive than Stripe at $50.

mainEntity.name: When do PayPal micropayments beat standard G&S?

acceptedAnswer.text: Micropayments (4.99% + $0.09 when enabled) cut the fixed fee. On very small tickets the higher percent can still win versus a $0.49 Checkout fixed fee; compare both schedules in the PayPal calculator before you enable micropayments account-wide.

mainEntity.name: Should creators avoid Patreon for $50 one-off tips?

acceptedAnswer.text: Patreon is built for memberships. Its blended default (platform + processing estimate) is much higher than a plain card processor on the same $50. For one-off tips, compare Ko-fi Free tips and Buy Me a Coffee against Stripe or PayPal G&S.
